PROCTOR.//Settings: Shipped defaults: every update replaces this file. To change a setting on this PC, put just that setting in %ProgramData%/PROCTOR/Server/appsettings.json (same layout, e.g. { "PROCTOR": { "AllowOpenTeacherMode": false, "TeacherCode": "..." } }) and restart the PROCTOR Classroom Service.
PROCTOR.//AllowOpenTeacherMode: When true, teachers join with no code (trusted lab VLAN). Set false to require TeacherCode.
PROCTOR.//AllowStrongControlsInOpenMode: In open mode, also allow the strongest controls: remote control, sending programs, log off / restart / shut down, internet off and closing programs. On: every control works without a code. Set false to keep them for teachers with a code (in open mode anyone on the network who opens a teacher app is a teacher).
PROCTOR.//TeacherCode: Used only when AllowOpenTeacherMode is false: the join code teachers type. Set it in the %ProgramData% settings file. (Empty + closed mode => a random code printed to the console, which a service has none of: always set one.)
PROCTOR.//Port: Kestrel HTTPS (TLS-only) port for the SignalR hub. Must match Protocol.DefaultServerPort unless clients are told otherwise via discovery.
PROCTOR.//CertificatePath: Optional. A PFX to use as the server's TLS identity. Empty => a self-signed certificate is created once in %ProgramData%\PROCTOR\Server and reused; its fingerprint is printed at start-up. Back it up: replacing it changes the fingerprint every agent and teacher has pinned.
PROCTOR.//AgentEnrollment: Open (default): a new PC is admitted and bound to its agent key the first time it registers; after that only that key can register as that PC. Key: new PCs must also present the lab EnrollmentKey (give it to agents with the MSI property ENROLLMENTKEY).
PROCTOR.//EnrollmentsPerAddressPerHour: New PCs that may enrol from one address per hour (and EnrollmentsPerTenMinutes server-wide), so a rogue program can't flood the server with made-up PCs. PCs not seen for 180 days are forgotten.
PROCTOR.//KeyEnrollmentsPerTenMinutes: PCs presenting the lab enrolment key skip the per-address limit but share this server-wide budget (in case the key leaks).
PROCTOR.//DiscoveryEnabled: UDP broadcast discovery on port 47800. Leave true on a normal lab LAN; clients can still connect by typing the server address when broadcast is blocked.
PROCTOR.//IceServers: Optional STUN/TURN relay for segmented networks where student and teacher can't reach each other directly, e.g. [ { "Urls": "turn:10.0.0.5:3478", "Username": "lab", "Credential": "secret" } ]. Empty on a flat lab LAN.
